movers.headline: declared **L-1 (lowest) bidder** for the **Sikasar-Kodar Reservoir Link Canal (pipeline)** under the Pairy Project, tendered by the **Water Resources Department, Government of Chhattisgarh** - **Rs 2,524.32 cr** excluding GST, lump-sum, **30-month** build plus **5 years of O&M**. L-1 is the lowest bid, not yet an award; the LoA is the event to watch.

board approves a **QIP of up to Rs 600 cr** (equity and/or eligible securities; postal ballot moved for shareholder approval) - alongside a **Rs 3/share interim dividend** (record date 3-Aug) and a **AED 15.3 mn (~Rs 40.25 cr) further infusion into its UAE wholly owned subsidiary, Transrail Trading LLC**. (The baseline printed that Rs 40.25 cr subsidiary infusion as the raise size - the omnibus board-outcome trap; fixed in code today.)

also **L-1** in the same Chhattisgarh WRD tender wave - the **Mohmela Sirpur Barrage on the Mahanadi** (Tahsil Arang, Dist. Raipur) with the full pipe-irrigation network and **5-year O&M**, contract value **Rs 568.98 cr** - roughly two-thirds of the company's market cap in one bid.

secures a **Rs 267.58 cr** (ex-GST) project from the **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)** - data-centre augmentation with enterprise server infrastructure at NPCI data centres, including **24x7x365 support and a 7-year warranty** commitment.

receives orders **totalling Rs 141.74 cr** (excluding taxes) from **Princeton Digital Group (India) Management** for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of **power-distribution systems**, delivered over **10 months** - a data-centre power order. (Invisible to the baseline until today: no amount anchor covered “orders totalling”.)
wins **two same-day work orders totalling Rs 35.76 cr** (Rs 18.15 cr + Rs 17.61 cr) from **MAHAJYOTI** - the Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Research & Training Institute, Government of Maharashtra, Nagpur.
(SME) receives **purchase orders aggregating Rs 6.46 cr** for supply - small in absolute terms, but ~19% of its market cap.
(SME) receives a **Rs 1.72 cr export purchase order** from **Eagle Agrotech Tanzania** for supply and installation of a **centre-pivot irrigation system**.

order_wins: **Dilip Buildcon** - L-1 bidder, Rs 2,524.32 cr Sikasar-Kodar link canal (pipeline), WRD Chhattisgarh; 30 months + 5-yr O&M (~35.5% of mcap).
**OM Infra** - L-1 bidder, Rs 568.98 cr Mohmela Sirpur Barrage + pipe-irrigation network, Mahanadi, Raipur; 5-yr O&M (~65.4% of mcap).
**Dynacons Systems & Solutions** - Rs 267.58 cr NPCI data-centre augmentation, 7-year warranty and support (~17.6% of mcap).
**Marine Electricals (India)** - Rs 141.74 cr power-distribution orders from Princeton Digital Group (India), 10-month delivery (~3.8% of mcap).
**Career Point Edutech** - Rs 35.76 cr, two same-day MAHAJYOTI work orders (Rs 18.15 cr + Rs 17.61 cr) (~10.1% of mcap).
**Rail Vikas Nigam (RVNL)** - Rs 358.97 cr LoA from East Central Railway (Kundawa Chainpur-Raxaul doubling, 41.04 km) - 0.78% of mcap, below the notability bar.
**Liotech Industries** (SME) - Rs 6.46 cr purchase orders (~18.6% of mcap).
**Chiraharit** (SME) - Rs 1.72 cr centre-pivot irrigation order from Eagle Agrotech Tanzania (~4.0% of mcap).
**Apollo Micro Systems** - awarded a **Make-II Prototype Sanction Order by the Indian Air Force / MoD** (value not stated) - the indigenous-development route, so the order value follows later.
**IRIS RegTech Solutions** - Phase-4 extension of the CODI deposit-insurance engagement with **Xpert Decisions Systems (XDS), South Africa** (value not disclosed).
**Icon Facilitators** (SME) - receipt of an order for technical services (value not disclosed).

**Larsen & Toubro** - a “Major” Buildings & Factories order in its own disclosure band; the same-day results filing shows **Q1 order inflow of Rs 108,014 cr**, which is a results metric, not this event.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Transrail Lighting** - board approves a **QIP of up to Rs 600 cr**; postal ballot moved for shareholder approval (~9.2% of mcap).
**Sadhana Nitro Chem** - BSE and NSE **in-principle approvals** received for the proposed preferential issue of 6,75,00,000 equity shares (rupee value not stated in the intimation).

_Not raises:_ Himatsingka Seide (NCDs), Unifinz Capital (Rs 50 cr secured NCDs), Mufin Green (Reg-29/50 debt-committee notice), STL Networks (fund-utilisation statement), Sambhv Steel (EGM-notice corrigendum).
equity_allotments: **Beryl Securities** - preferential-issue allotment of ~**Rs 2.98 cr** (execution of a prior approval - never a mover).
**Fusion Finance** - conversion of partly paid-up shares into fully paid-up, and **forfeiture** of the rest, from the Mar-2025 rights issue (~Rs 1.5 cr).
business_updates: **Results season** - **137 companies** filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, transcripts, presentations - Coal India, Ambuja, Colgate-Palmolive, City Union Bank, Coforge, Tata Communications, VBL, Equitas, Sundaram Clayton, UFO Moviez and many more) - tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Alembic Pharmaceuticals** - **USFDA final approval for Prucalopride Tablets** (1 mg and 2 mg).
**Glenmark Pharmaceuticals** - US launch of **Sugammadex Injection 200 mg/2 mL** through Glenmark Inc, USA.
**ZF CV Control Systems India** - secures **ESC (electronic stability control) business nominations from three major OEMs** ahead of the Indian mandate.
**Coal India** - Q1 FY27 **capex up 16.64%**, ahead of its quarterly target.
**Pajson Agro** (SME) - Q1 FY27 voluntary update: **Rs 67.94 cr estimated revenue and order book**.
**Meenakshi India** - **lists on the BSE main board** at Rs 281.99; the “Rs 500 cr by 2030” in its note is an aspiration, not a number we print.
distress_risk: **Osia Hyper Retail** - prior intimation of the **4th CoC meeting** (in CIRP).
**Astron Paper & Board Mills** - **invitation of resolution plans** under s.25(2)(h) of the IBC.
**Inox Green Energy** / **Authum Investment & Infrastructure** - **NCLT approves** the consortium's resolution in the **Wind World (India)** matter (the acquiring side of a distress deal).
**Max Estates** - **show-cause notice** received in a subsidiary.
**Jagran Prakashan** - promoter-family company petition (Mahendra Mohan Gupta & Ors. v. Devendra Mohan Gupta & Ors.).
**Nitin Castings** - **voluntary delisting** Letter of Offer from the BSE.
**Lords Mark Industries** - clarification on trading status under IBC / IRP Stage-1.
other_notable: **Debt - dropped per §3, never movers:** Unifinz Capital's Rs 50 cr secured NCDs (private placement), Himatsingka Seide's Rs 12.75 cr Tranche-2 Series-E NCDs, Nimbus Projects' Rs 40 cr ICICI term loan and Rs 23 cr guarantee, R&B Denims' Rs 4 cr loan agreement, Mufin Green's Reg-29/50 committee notice.
**Highway Infrastructure** - **Infomerics assigns IVR BBB+/Stable** (Rs 200.88 cr of bank facilities rated) - a rating event, not an order.
**Jonjua Overseas** - bonus issue approved in a **7:24** ratio, subject to approvals (corporate action, never a mover).
**State Bank of India** - publishes the **ESG ratings** assigned by SEBI-registered ESG rating providers (unsolicited, no engagement).

tally: 2026-07-28: 1,327 announcements captured (00:17-22:52 IST), 322 material rows in the baseline -> ~60 curated lines. The day's real signal was **Chhattisgarh's Water Resources Department**: two link-canal / barrage tenders put **Dilip Buildcon (Rs 2,524.32 cr, L-1)** and **OM Infra (Rs 568.98 cr, L-1)** at the top - both still *lowest bidder*, not awarded. Behind them three clean orders: **Dynacons' Rs 267.58 cr NPCI data-centre** build, **Marine Electricals' Rs 141.74 cr** power-distribution order from Princeton Digital Group, and **Career Point Edutech's Rs 35.76 cr** MAHAJYOTI work orders; **Transrail** approved a **Rs 600 cr QIP**. The structural story is the digest's own: the baseline's four leaders (Highway Infra, Nimbus x2, R&B Denims) were **loans and a credit rating** promoted by the “ loa”-matches-“loan” bug, and a **Rs 50 cr NCD** was starred as a marquee equity allotment - all four classes are fixed in code, and Marine's and Career Point's orders were recovered in the same pass. Real thematic depth elsewhere: **Dalmia Bharat's LoI for Bhilai Jaypee Cement** (2.2 MnTPA grinding + 1.1 MnTPA clinker) out of insolvency, **Tanla / UPL / Crizac / Grob Tea** M&A, **Tembo's UAV JV** and **Lloyds' Flyfocus** defence tie-up, and USFDA / product wins at **Alembic** and **Glenmark**.
